steps.js: const rows=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-shot]')]; let ver=0, draft=0, verBtn=0, draftBtn=0, inMenu=0; for (const r of rows) { const tiles=[...r.querySelectorAll('[class*=tile], [class*=frame]')].filter(t=>t.getBoundingClientRect().width>40 && /首帧|尾帧/.test(t.innerText) && !/视频/.test(t.innerText.slice(0,6))); for (const t of tiles) { const hasNum=/#\s*\d+/.test(t.innerText); const isDraft=/草图|渲染中|未出/.test(t.innerText) && !hasNum; const btn=[...t.querySelectorAll('button')].some(b=>/再生成/.test(b.innerText+b.title)); if (hasNum) { ver++; if (btn) verBtn++; } else if (isDraft) { draft++; if (btn) draftBtn++; } } } inMenu=[...document.querySelectorAll('details.ds-tilebar-more button, .v3-menu button')].filter(b=>/再生成/.test(b.innerText)).length; return {rows:rows.length, versionedTiles:ver, versionedWithBtn:verBtn, draftOrRendering:draft, draftWithBtn:draftBtn, regenInsideMenus:inMenu};

const m=document.querySelector('.ds-modal'); const a=document.activeElement; return {modal:!!m, role:m?.getAttribute('role'), focusIsTextarea:a?.tagName==='TEXTAREA', mode:document.querySelector('.regen-mode')?.innerText};

const sel=[...document.querySelectorAll('.ds-modal select')]; const who=sel.find(s=>s.getAttribute('aria-label')==='谁的装备'); if (who && !who.value && who.options.length>1) { who.value=who.options[1].value; who.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); } return {mode:document.querySelector('.regen-mode')?.innerText, selects:sel.map(s=>s.getAttribute('aria-label')+'='+(s.options[s.selectedIndex]?.text||'')), submitDisabled:[...document.querySelectorAll('.ds-modal button')].find(b=>b.innerText.trim()==='生成')?.disabled}
